faqs.q: What is the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose used for?
faqs.a: This food-grade PVC suction and delivery hose, part code PREMVIN, moves abrasive and non-abrasive solids or liquids, including diluted chemicals. It has a spring steel reinforcement and is listed in 12 sizes from 13 mm to 152 mm. This listing carries 12 part numbers, covering 1/2" to 6".

faqs.q: Which sizes is the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose available in?
faqs.a: The Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose is listed in 12 sizes, from 13 mm to 152 mm inner diameter, for example IH-IH-PREMVIN-013, IH-IH-PREMVIN-051 and IH-IH-PREMVIN-152. Working pressure, burst pressure and bend radius change with size, so read the row for your bore in the size table and give us the bore, assembly length and end fittings on the enquiry.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose?
faqs.a: Choose the bore for the flow you need, then check that size's working pressure in the table: it falls from 12 bar at the smallest bore to 2 bar at 152 mm. Pick this hose for abrasive food solids and light chemicals, and a San-hygienic NBR or silicone hose where the lining must meet hygiene rules.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose have?
faqs.a: The Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose has a maximum working pressure of 2-12 bar depending on size, a minimum burst pressure of 7-36 bar and a safety factor of 3:1. The working pressure is a size-by-size figure, so use the value in the size table for your bore, and do not exceed the lower of hose and coupling ratings.

faqs.q: What is the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose made from?
faqs.a: The hose is PVC tube construction with no separate cover or lining, reinforced with spring steel. PVC handles abrasion well and is light, but it is not suited to hot fluids, since the listing gives -10 °C to +55 °C.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose?
faqs.a: The listing describes the hose as food grade PVC but names no FDA or EU regulation and holds no migration certificate. If your plant needs a declaration of compliance, say so in the enquiry; our [food-grade hose compliance guide](/blog/food-grade-hose-compliance) explains what to ask for.

faqs.q: Which parts does the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose mate with?
faqs.a: The Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose is assembled with matching couplings and accessories, such as cam and groove couplings, hose clamps and permanently attached fittings. Say what fittings you need on the enquiry; our [hose guides and shelf](/c/food-beverage-hoses) cover the matching hardware.

faqs.q: How should the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: For the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose, specify the inner diameter, the assembly length and the end fittings, and keep the bend radius at or above the minimum listed for your size in the size table. Flush and clean the hose before first food contact, and replace it when the lining shows cracks, swelling or soft spots.

faqs.q: Where is the Food & Bulk PVC suction and delivery hose used?
faqs.a: The listing names food grade transfer of abrasive and non-abrasive solids or liquids, including diluted chemicals. It suits bulk food, grain and sugar handling, and light chemical transfer where the PVC lining is compatible.

faqs.a: The Premvin hose has spring steel reinforcement, 12 sizes to 152 mm and a working pressure of 2 to 12 bar, while [the PVC non toxic suction and delivery hose](/p/pvc-non-toxic-suction-delivery-hose) has a PVC spiral helix, 6 sizes from 25 mm to 76 mm and 4 to 8 bar. Choose Premvin for abrasive bulk and the spiral hose for lighter food duty.
